item.summary: fix(slack): drop the tool-call receipt from finished progress cards (#123851) The Block Kit session card terminalized into a '🛠️ N tool calls · ⏱️ Ns' footer, leaving a per-turn receipt in the Slack transcript on the default progress path. PR #122976 deleted the same receipt from the native progress surface but left this sibling rendering it. Finished cards now keep only the durable diff stat and the session link; tool-call and elapsed counters stay live working state. Also corrects the documented channels.slack.streaming.mode default, stale since #122552.
